description:
Verify a Schnorr co-signature against a BIP-341 sighash. Use this to confirm that a co-signer's signature is valid before combining and broadcasting. Read-only — no wallet unlock required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

pubkey.description: Signer's x-only public key as 32-byte hex string (64 hex chars). Obtain via taproot_get_pubkey from each co-signer.

sighash.description: BIP-341 sighash as 32-byte hex string (64 hex chars). This is the transaction commitment that was signed.

signature.description: Schnorr signature as 64-byte hex string (128 hex chars, BIP-340 format).

name: taproot_verify_cosig
